text:
tara: FYI Kevin asked for SOC2/ISO evidence focused on service-account provisioning and KMS usage. Specifically: (1) RBAC approval trail for any prod SA created since 2025-10-01, (2) KMS Decrypt event samples showing which principals touched model keys, and (3) a concise CVE-2025-1122 triage summary + timeline. Can someone take ownership? :mag:

kevin_auditor: Hi team  For item (1) we need the PR/ticket approval artifact + the merged manifest diff and the k8s audit log snippet showing the create event and the approver. For (2) provide raw CloudTrail Decrypt JSON entries including eventTime, requestParameters.keyId, userIdentity.principalId; redaction of sourceIPAddress is OK but keep principalId and keyId. For (3) one-paragraph root-cause + 4-step timeline with timestamps and links to runbook/PRs. Deliver as a single zip with a manifest.json mapping artifacts to SOC2 control CC6 and ISO A.9. Deadline: next Wed EOD.

mike: I can own RBAC. Plan: export merged PR diffs from infra-team/iam with label "service-account" since 2025-10-01, capture JIRA approval screenshots, and snapshot k8s audit events for SA create. I'll pick three random SA creations across teams and produce a CSV mapping SA email -> requester -> approver -> PR. Also include a short separation-of-duties policy excerpt and a proof snippet showing approver != author.

tara: For k8s audit extraction use this jq filter I run locally: ```bash
jq -c 'select(.verb=="create" and .objectRef.resource=="serviceaccounts")' /var/log/k8s-audit/audit.log | grep -E '2025-(10|11|12|01|02|03)' > sa-create-events.json
``` Include full event JSON for the auditor.

mike: I'll also export rolebinding snapshots and infra manifest diffs. Example GH CLI I use: ```bash
gh pr list --repo infra-team/iam --search "merged:>2025-10-01 label:service-account" --state merged --json number,author,mergedAt,body > sa-prs.json
```

infra-bot: evidence-bundle job scheduled when artifacts present. Staging prefix: s3://redwood-evidence/pending/3277770000/. Job ID ev-3277770000.

tara: I'll take KMS and the CVE notes. KMS plan: pull CloudTrail Decrypt events for our model key ARNs between 2025-10-01 and 2026-03-01 then crosswalk principalId to k8s SA UIDs from Mike's CSV. CLI I'll run: ```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt --start-time 2025-10-01T00:00:00Z --end-time 2026-03-01T00:00:00Z --max-results 200 > decrypt-events.json
``` Then verify in Splunk: `index=cloudtrail_kms eventName=Decrypt requestParameters.keyId="arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/*" | table _time eventName userIdentity.principalId requestParameters.keyId sourceIPAddress`

kevin_auditor: Good. Keep at least five raw JSON samples. Redact IPs if they contain personal info but keep principalId and keyId. Also include keypolicy.md that documents rotation cadence and primary contacts.

mike: Two quick notes: 1) Some SAs are created by infra automation (bot accounts). For those we'll include the PR showing automation run + the human approval ticket. 2) We'll flag any SA that was both created and approved by the same user (should be rare) and explain the exception in exceptions.txt.

tara: For the CVE-2025-1122 triage I'll draft this summary (will refine): "2026-02-10 03:12 UTC: alert triggered for a spike in inference runtime errors. 03:28 UTC: on-call identified suspicious malformed metadata being sent to runtime; 03:40 UTC: triage determined root cause was a vulnerability in grpc v1.49 that allowed metadata injection. 04:05 UTC: temporary ingress filter applied to block malformed headers; 05:30 UTC: runtime image rebuilt with grpc v1.50.2 and deployed to canary; 08:50 UTC: full rollout complete. No evidence of customer-data exfiltration. Added CI regression test to detect malformed metadata. Runbook: INC-5122, PR: infra-team/runtime#1205."

kevin_auditor: That reads well. Please ensure each timeline line has a timestamp and link. Also include a one-line root cause and whether there was any customer impact.

mike: I'll stage RBAC artifacts to the staging prefix: s3://redwood-evidence/pending/3277770000/rbac/: files expected: pr-1620-diff.patch, pr-1701-diff.patch, jira-1620-approval.png, sa-mapping.csv, rbinding-snapshots.json, separation_of_duties.md

tara: Uploading kms artifacts now to s3://redwood-evidence/pending/3277770000/kms/: decrypt-events-sample.json, splunk-matches.csv, keypolicy.md, correlation_notes.txt, triage-summary.md, pr-runtime-1205.patch

evidence-bot: Evidence bundler detected artifacts and started job ev-3277770000. ETA 35 minutes. Output: s3://redwood-evidence/finished/3277770000/evidence.zip

mike: I've included a small README.md describing our redaction policy (we redact IP addresses and internal hostnames; principalId and keyId preserved). exceptions.txt will list one dev-hostname redaction and one redaction reason for a customer email that was removed.

kevin_auditor: Great. After bundling please DM the presigned URL and ensure manifest.json maps each artifact to SOC2 control CC6 and ISO A.9. If we need extra logs we'll request them but this should be sufficient for initial evidence review.

tara: Will assemble manifest.json and exceptions.txt and then confirm with infra-bot to finalize the bundle. ETA before Wed EOD. :white_check_mark:
